QuestInfo.name: The Path of a Knight
QuestInfo.0: It's time to receive the last test given by #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k in order to become a Knight-in-Training.
QuestInfo.1: An eternal loyalty towards the Empress. The courage to stand up to the Black Mage. The will power required to keep your faith intact. As long as you don't forget these three, you'll be able to fight until the very end as a proud member of Cygnus Knights.
